description.value: Kabuki Sushi is a Japanese and Asian restaurant in Pitt Meadows serving sushi and other dishes made with fresh ingredients. The restaurant offers both dine-in with table reservations and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for cyclists riding the Pitt Meadows area. Its name pays homage to the highly stylised classical Japanese dance-drama known for elaborate costumes and detailed movement.

address.value: 12522 Harris Rd, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2J4
